comment: 2D sprite sheets in vdata/ (tools/gfx/sprites.py). sprite = [w, h] of each sprite (1D-mapped tiles); rect is relative to the sprite.

majan/btn_naki.comment: Call buttons: 0-8 grey (inactive), 9-17 orange (active): Pon Chii Kan Ron Tsumo Riichi OpenRiichi NineTerminals Cancel.

majan/obj_naki_effect.comment: Call shouts shown over the table.

majan/btn_common.comment: Prompt buttons. The game draws the copy embedded in ARM9 (identical to vdata/majan/btn_common.gcd, which nothing loads); top 16 rows of each sprite, striped background restored row by row.

majan/btn_msg.comment: Yes/No buttons (ARM9-embedded copy; the vdata file is unused): 0-1 normal, 2-3 selected.

majan/obj_chiicha.comment: Starting-dealer (chiicha) marker: each wind in four rotations, one per seat's viewing direction (0, 90, 180, 270 degrees counter-clockwise).

majan/obj_strAgari1.comment: Gold limit banner 役満: drawn as [役][満].

majan/obj_strAgari2.comment: Silver limit banners built from 跳/満/三/倍: [跳][満] Haneman, [倍][満] Baiman, [三][倍][満] Sanbaiman; the romaji splits at the same places.

majan/obj_strAgari3.comment: Bronze limit banner 満貫: drawn as [満][貫].

arm9/round_banner.comment: Glyph sheet for the round banner (e.g. 東一局００本場) composed from 16x16 cells: winds and numbers (row 0), 局 本 場 オ ー ラ ス (row 1), digits (row 2). Wind letters sit right and numbers left in their cells so they read 'E1'; 局 is blank.

dict/dicup0.comment: Dictionary title screen: title on the black band between the white lines (rows 71-120).

dict/dicup1.comment: Dictionary title screen: title on the black band between the white lines (rows 71-120).

dict/dicup6.comment: Framed page with a small heading on the frame's top line (y 32).

dict/dicup7.comment: Framed page with a small heading on the frame's top line (y 32).

dict/dic_menu_button.comment: Dictionary top menu buttons (128x32): two images stored on alternate rows. Even rows: Glossary / Yaku List, odd rows: Fu Table / Scores; top half normal, bottom half selected.

dict/dicdown3.comment: Fu table page. Text is erased by palette index (yellow 175 / white 207 plus a 1 px ring) and refilled from the same row, which keeps the page's shading; tile pictures are left alone.

dict/dicdown4.comment: Fu table page. Text is erased by palette index (yellow 175 / white 207 plus a 1 px ring) and refilled from the same row, which keeps the page's shading; tile pictures are left alone.

dict/dicdown5.comment: Fu table page. Text is erased by palette index (yellow 175 / white 207 plus a 1 px ring) and refilled from the same row, which keeps the page's shading; tile pictures are left alone.

guide/bg_guide_title.comment: Tutorial heading sheet: 80x24 rows 麻雀入門 / Step1 / Step2 / Step3 (only the first is Japanese). Mahjong Basics does not fit 80 px at heading size, so it reads Basics.

arm9/pause_mode_label.comment: Match pause/standings overlay, top-left game-mode label (func_02087c80 blits one 72x32 cell at (10,16); cell 0 is drawn 8 px lower because it holds a single line). Cells: 0 Free Play, 1 Ranking Mode, 2 Challenge Mode. Each second line is drawn over the first line's bottom ring, as in the original.

arm9/pause_wind.comment: Match pause/standings overlay: 40x40 seat-wind boxes beside each player's portrait (func_02087c80). Column = wind (E S W N); row 0 is the player's blue box, row 1 the opponents' pink box. The 34x34 interior is a flat fill, cleared and redrawn.

majan/obj_strResult.comment: Draw banner words, 32x32 pieces laid side by side (func_0207aae4). The sprite slots are re-split for English and asm/result_words.asm lists which pieces each word uses; keep the two in step. 'Four' is shared and right-aligned, the word after it left-aligned, so the pieces join with a normal space.

arm9/menu_header_plates.comment: Top-screen header plates of the options / rule screens (func_0209dd34 blits 208x32 cell i from this 624-wide sheet): Option Settings, Rule Settings, Rule List. Same look as the Main Menu plate in TexMenu; text area between the red end dots is restored row by row from column 19 of each cell.

arm9/header_results.comment: Top-screen title headers blitted from ARM9 bitmaps through the descriptor table at 0x0210E030 ({sheet width, w, h, data, palette, src x, src y}). End-of-match results and score check, 80x24 each.

arm9/header_wireless.comment: Top-screen title headers blitted from ARM9 bitmaps through the descriptor table at 0x0210E030 ({sheet width, w, h, data, palette, src x, src y}). DS Wireless Play screens.

arm9/header_download.comment: Top-screen title headers blitted from ARM9 bitmaps through the descriptor table at 0x0210E030 ({sheet width, w, h, data, palette, src x, src y}). DS Download Play screens.

arm9/header_ranking_points.comment: Top-screen title headers blitted from ARM9 bitmaps through the descriptor table at 0x0210E030 ({sheet width, w, h, data, palette, src x, src y}). Ranking Mode points screen: title (152x24) and two small labels (80x12 at y 24, 60x12 at y 40).
